items.name: DEWU Beauty Dashboard
items.summary: Beauty market command center — GMV, share, price bands, and SKU ranks in one view. Switch to competitor mode and brand mix, share shifts, and ranking tables update together.

items.name: Nike Legal Dashboard
items.summary: Nike brand-protection cockpit for digital takedowns, e-commerce mix, and on-the-ground market cleanup. Maps, platform scores, and role-based workflows turn enforcement from scattered files into a live operating system.

items.name: DEWU FTW Quarterly Report
items.summary: A full quarterly resale PPT — cover shots, charts, product grids, and insight tables — generated end to end. Every image, number, and table is assembled by the pipeline. No slide is built by hand.

items.name: Notion Knowledge Agent
items.summary: A personal agent wired to my Notion library. It pulls ebooks, writes the summary, drafts notes, and pushes them back to Notion — from bookshelf to structured knowledge in one loop.
